messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Titration: Follow the dosage escalation schedule, titrating every 30 days to achieve the maintenance dosage.
Maintenance dose: 25 mg orally once daily for cardiovascular risk reduction and weight reduction in adults.
Rybelsus Dosing Information:
Take Rybelsus at least 30 minutes before the first food, beverage, or other oral medications of the day with no more than 4 ounces of plain water only.
After 30 minutes of taking Semaglutide, you may eat, drink, or take other oral medicines.
Swallow tablets whole.
Do not split, crush, or chew tablets.
Rybelsus Recommended Dosage R1 formulation
Start Rybelsus with 3 mg once daily for 30 days.
The 3 mg dose is intended for treatment initiation.
It is not effective for glycemic control.
After 30 days on the 3 mg dose, increase the dose to 7 mg once daily.
Dose may be increased to 14 mg once daily.
This increase is needed if additional glycemic control is required.
This requirement applies after at least 30 days on the 7 mg dose.
Taking two 7 mg Rybelsus tablets to achieve a 14 mg dose is not recommended.
Triplet: ["Semaglutide", "has dosage escalation schedule", "titrate every 30 days to achieve maintenance dosage"]

The relation 'has dosage escalation schedule' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a structured plan for increasing the dose over time to reach a maintenance dosage.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose increment': The subject drug's dose is increased by the specified amount at regular intervals.
B. 'dose adjustment responsibility': The entity specified by the object is responsible for making changes to the dose of the subject drug.
C. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
D. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
E. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
